$comment: WhatsApp messaging is switched off, so the daily reminder run is unscheduled. The endpoint and its dispatcher are intact — restoring it means putting back: { "path": "/api/cron/reminders", "schedule": "30 4 * * *" }. The sheet-sync entry is a safety net rather than the mechanism: every mutation mirrors itself as it happens, and this only picks up a rebuild that failed because Google was briefly unreachable. Hobby plans allow one run a day, which is why it is daily; on Pro, */15 * * * * makes the worst case fifteen minutes instead of a day.
